nodes.label: Tesla Design System
nodes.rationale: Radical subtraction: the product photography is everything and the interface is designed to be almost nothing, avoiding shadows/gradients so nothing competes with the vehicles.

nodes.label: Universal Sans (Display/Text) Font Family
nodes.rationale: Replaced Gotham to unify the website, mobile app, and in-car software into a single typographic voice across Tesla's whole digital ecosystem.
